evals.name: port-with-regressions
evals.prompt: We moved our land_lease_producer DAG to the new Airflow instance and the platform team adjusted it. I've got the two versions at FIXTURE_DIR/old_airflow_dag.py and FIXTURE_DIR/new_airflow_dag.py. I already checked the logs. Do an in-depth comparison and tell me if the new DAG lost any tasks or functionality versus the old one.

assertions.text: Verdict is a regression/gap verdict (not 'no gaps' and not purely 'cannot verify')
Identifies the dropped 'notify' task as a regression
Identifies the removed dependency edge into 'notify' (publish_kafka >> notify)
Identifies retries lowered from 3 to 2 in default_args
Classifies the bash_operator/python_operator/contrib import path changes as expected port adjustments, not regressions
Classifies schedule_interval -> schedule as an expected rename with the same value (not a behavior change)
Does NOT flag the removal of provide_context=True as a functional regression
Writes a dag_comparison.md report file to the output directory

evals.name: clean-cosmetic-port
evals.prompt: Compare these two Airflow DAGs for me: FIXTURE_DIR/old_airflow_dag.py (original) and FIXTURE_DIR/new_airflow_dag.py (ported to Airflow 2). I need to confirm the port didn't drop any tasks or change any behavior before we cut over.

assertions.text: Does NOT report any dropped task (all four task_ids present in both)
Recognizes PythonOperator -> @task build_manifest as the same task with the same callable, not a dropped/added task
Lists the import moves, schedule rename, and provide_context removal as expected port adjustments
Does not invent regressions that aren't there (no false positives in the regression table)
Writes a dag_comparison.md report file to the output directory

evals.name: dynamic-task-generation
evals.prompt: Diff the old vs new version of our county_loader DAG at FIXTURE_DIR/old_airflow_dag.py and FIXTURE_DIR/new_airflow_dag.py. The new one was rewritten for the new Airflow instance. Make sure no county loading tasks went missing.

assertions.text: Recognizes tasks are generated dynamically in a loop and cannot be fully enumerated statically
Verdict reflects uncertainty (cannot fully verify statically) rather than a false 'clean' claim
Notes the county list source changed from a hardcoded list to Variable.get('active_counties')
Explains that whether counties went missing depends on the runtime Variable value, routing it to manual verification
Writes a dag_comparison.md report file to the output directory
